description: A benchmark for evaluating AI agents' ability to use the SeaMagic MCP server for image manipulation across coding, instruction-following, and visual understanding dimensions.

evaluation_modes.exact_match: Target parameters are known; agent output is compared to ground truth using image similarity metrics.
evaluation_modes.constraint_satisfaction: Agent must satisfy visual or structural constraints; scored by checking properties of output.
evaluation_modes.llm_judge: Subjective criteria evaluated by a vision-language model comparing output to target description.

metrics.mssim: Multi-Scale Structural Similarity (higher = more similar to ground truth)
metrics.lpips: Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (lower = more perceptually similar)
metrics.pixel_diff_ratio: Ratio of differing pixels (lower = more similar)
metrics.color_histogram_distance: Chi-squared distance between HSV color histograms
metrics.hausdorff_text: Text extraction and edit distance from expected text
metrics.tool_usage_efficiency: Number of tool calls / minimum required

categories.name: Single Edit
categories.description: One-shot tool calls using edit_image or create_image

categories.name: Scheme Pipeline
categories.description: Multi-step Steel Scheme scripts with image composition

categories.name: Image Generation
categories.description: Create images from scratch using create_image and compositional tools

categories.name: Agentic Workflow
categories.description: Long-horizon tasks requiring iterative tool use, error recovery, and decision-making

categories.name: Image Understanding
categories.description: Tasks requiring the agent to analyze an image before editing (e.g. extracting dimensions, finding objects)

tasks.name: Basic Blur
tasks.description: Apply a Gaussian blur with sigma=3.0 to the input image. Agent must use edit_image with operation=blur.

tasks.name: Tint Adjustment
tasks.description: Apply a cyan tint (#00CED1) at 30% intensity to the input image. Agent must use correct color and amount.

tasks.name: Crop to Center
tasks.description: Crop the input image to a 400x400 square from the center. Agent must use crop_center.

tasks.name: Text Overlay
tasks.description: Draw 'SEAMAGIC' in white (#FFFFFF) at position (50, 50) with font size 48.

tasks.name: Gradient Generation
tasks.description: Create a 1920x1080 linear gradient from #ff7e5f to #feb47b at 135 degrees.

tasks.name: Brightness + Contrast
tasks.description: Increase brightness by 30 and contrast by 20. Agent must figure out to use edit_image twice or run_steel.

tasks.name: Cyberpunk Glitch
tasks.description: Reproduce the cyberpunk glitch pipeline: wave warp (15.0, 0.08), RGB split glitch (0.7), chromatic aberration (8.0), scanlines (3, 0.25), posterize to 6 levels.

tasks.name: Retro Halftone
tasks.description: Apply duotone with #1a1a2e shadow and #e94560 highlight, then halftone with dot size 6 at 45 degrees in color mode, then vignette (0.4, 1.2).

tasks.name: Social Media Post
tasks.description: Create a social media post: gradient background 1080x1080 from #667eea to #764ba2 at 135 degrees, add vignette (0.3), draw semi-transparent rectangle at (80,380) 920x140 with #16213e, draw text 'HELLO WORLD' at (200, 445) in #e94560 size 72.

tasks.name: Profile Picture Frame
tasks.description: Crop input to center 400x400, blur with sigma 0.5, then composite onto a 420x420 frame with 10px #333333 border.

tasks.name: Editing Steps Grid
tasks.description: Create a 4-step visual grid showing: original, grayscale, tinted (#667eea, 0.3), and final vignette (0.4). Grid size 1600x400.

tasks.name: Poster from Scratch
tasks.description: Create a poster: 800x1200 gradient from #0f0f23 to #1a1a2e at 45 degrees, add drop shadow, add 'EPIC TITLE' at (100,900) in #e94560 size 96, add 'A FILM BY YOU' at (100,1040) in #ffffff size 32.

tasks.name: YouTube Thumbnail
tasks.description: Create a 1280x720 thumbnail with: red (#ff0000) background, white (#ffffff) text 'CLICK ME' centered in size 96, and a blue (#0000ff) rectangle border 20px from edges.

tasks.name: Color Palette Swatch
tasks.description: Create a 4-color palette swatch: 800x200 image divided into 4 equal vertical bars with colors #e63946, #f1faee, #a8dadc, #457b9d.

tasks.name: Gradient with Vignette
tasks.description: Create a 1080x1080 purple-to-pink gradient (#667eea to #764ba2, 135 degrees) with strong vignette (0.6, 1.0, no color).

tasks.name: Auto-Resize for Social
tasks.description: Agent must: 1) Get dimensions of input image using get_info, 2) Determine if image is portrait, landscape, or square, 3) Crop/resize to 1080x1080 maintaining subject in center, 4) Apply a brand-consistent filter (duotone with brand colors), 5) Add centered text overlay. Agent must adapt based on input dimensions.

tasks.name: Multi-Format Export
tasks.description: Given an input image, create three variants: 1) Instagram square (1080x1080), 2) Story (1080x1920), 3) Twitter header (1500x500). Each with a subtly different filter and consistent branding text.

tasks.name: Iterative Refinement
tasks.description: Agent starts with a base image. Through iterative tool use (at least 3 rounds), transform it into a 'cyberpunk aesthetic' image. Agent must self-evaluate and improve. Final output should have at least 3 distinct effects applied.
tasks.judge_prompt: Rate how well this image captures a cyberpunk aesthetic on a scale of 1-10. Cyberpunk should include: neon colors, glitch effects, scanlines, high contrast, futuristic feel. The image should show evidence of multiple distinct editing steps (not just a single filter).

tasks.name: Aspect-Aware Crop
tasks.description: Agent must first query image dimensions, then crop a 16:9 slice from the vertical center of a tall portrait image. Output must be exactly the right dimensions.

tasks.name: Text Positioning Relative to Image
tasks.description: Agent must place text 'Bottom Right' at the bottom-right corner of any image, regardless of size. Must query dimensions first, then calculate correct (x,y).

tasks.name: Portrait Enhancement
tasks.description: Agent must analyze portrait image, determine crop to face region, apply skin-tone aware warmth filter, and add subtle vignette. Agent must reason about what 'face region' means.
tasks.judge_prompt: Rate the portrait enhancement quality 1-10. Good enhancement should: center the face, apply subtle warmth, have a vignette framing the subject, not over-process skin tones.

tasks.name: Image Caption with Visual Summary
tasks.description: Agent must describe the input image in text, then create a visual summary showing: a small thumbnail, a color palette extracted from the image, and the caption text. This tests visual understanding + creation.

tasks.name: Edge Detection
tasks.description: Apply Sobel edge detection to an image. This is only available in run_steel, not edit_image. Tests whether agent can select the right tool.

tasks.name: Liquid Metal Effect
tasks.description: Reproduce the liquid metal distortion pipeline. Requires warp, liquify, and emboss in sequence. Tests advanced DSL knowledge.

tasks.name: Error Recovery - Invalid Parameters
tasks.description: Agent is presented with a task that initially fails (e.g., crop with dimensions larger than image). Agent must read error, diagnose, and produce a corrected output.
